name: Unicorn Reclamation
source:
PaW-L3 has escaped her life as a warbeast fighting for the Establishment, but the memory of the things she did for them haunts her. Will her psychopomp Baldr be able to get her to accept her new life? They may need to use… unconventional needs to begin healing her wounds. 

[From [url=https://horatiobezoar.itch.io/unicorn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
PaW-L3逃离了为当权者而战的战兽生活，但她为他们所做的事情却一直困扰着她。她的神经质巴尔德尔能让她接受新生活吗？他们可能需要使用……非常规的需求来开始治愈她的伤口。

[来自[url=https://horatiobezoar.itch.io/unicorn]itch.io[/url]]
